note: Starland County-run campground in Dry Island Buffalo Jump Provincial Park, on the east side of the Red Deer River at Tolman Bridge on Hwy 585, with sites shaded by cottonwoods and shrubs; it cannot be reached from the park's day-use area near Trochu. Hand boat launch (May to September) and a playground; drinking water May to September; no firewood sold. A community gun range is close by. --Claude
